scope: Proposition 6.11 (Binary time estimate) of the manuscript “Critical local smoothing for the three-dimensional wave equation” (preprints/Critical-local-smoothing-for-the-three-dimensional-wave-equation-September-24-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 079 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 79299093c07ea305), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 98. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Assume quadratic admissible data, m > 0, c > 3, and line avoidance. At a binary layer p → 2p, freeze contact coefficients at Fp, and let bmiss(p) = p−1 Hδ F2p | Fp,2p, D, (Li, Lj)2p  in the limiting entropy law. Then 0 ≤ bmiss ≤ 1 and e(p) ≥ bmiss(p) + 2m. Put r0 = c 2−⌊log2 c⌋ ∈ [1, 2). For the time lower bound, the term (c − 1)|Gi| in (time-rate) may be replaced by 1 2 h (c − r0)(ᾱ − b̄miss) + (r0 − 1)(ᾱ − 1) i . (bin)
